top_violation_types.title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §746.301(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation allowed a 5 year old child in care before requesting that Child Care Regulation amend their permit to add ages 5 years and up. The operation is currently permitted to care for only children between 0-4 years.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a smoke detection system.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on interviews with staff and observation of the operation confirms rodent feces present in the classrooms. Rodent feces was seen in vicinity of furniture and children's toys.
